messages.subject: Plotting point and line - y labels format in hour
parts:
Hi,

I am new in ggplot2.

Right now I am trying to plot with lines the sunset and the sunrise function of the date. Nothing difficult. And then I would like to plot with point some other values.

First question : is it possible to change the geom function of a value of a variable ? like color but for line and point.

My dataframe is something like this and called WW:
Date Sunrise Sunset Stop_time_H Start_time_H
30/03/2012 07:05 19:51
31/03/2012 07:03 19:52
01/04/2012 07:01 19:54 19:39
02/04/2012 06:59 19:55 7:03

The best option that I found was everything with line with : 

ggplot(subset(melt(WW,id.vars='Date',na.rm=TRUE),value!=''),aes(Date,as.numeric(value),color=variable))+geom_line(size=1)

2nd question : How to change y axis with hour format ? I found soemthing but only for dates.

I am sure I am using not the optimal code, since the beginning so if you have also advice for this (data manipulating ...) ...

Thanks for your help.

Dorian.

parts: >I am now looking to change labels in y axis and maybe a way to plot with midnight as 0,5 value (with right label in hour on y axis)

What about plotting the values as times, not numerics--does that do what you want?

b$timevalue <- strptime( b$value, format="%H:%M" )

c$timevalue <- strptime( c$value, format="%H:%M" )


(and then plot these two new variables)

Ben

Hi Dorian,

The only way I could get this to work is by cheating, but it does work:

# Calculate time difference from midnight
LL2$difftime <- difftime( LL2$value, strptime( '2012-03-12 12:00:00',
format='%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' ) )

# Now plot the new variable, with custom labels

JJSunset<-subset(JJ2,variable=='Sunset')
JJSunrise<-subset(JJ2,variable=='Sunrise')
ggplot(JJ2,aes(Date,difftime))+geom_line(aes(Date,difftime,color=variable),size=1)
+geom_point(data=LL2,aes(Date,difftime,shape=Lake),size=3)+ylab('Time')
+guides(color=guide_legend(title=''))
+scale_shape_manual(values=c(1,3,17))
